subject: english
title: Unit 3 Review & School Activities
subTitle: Lessons 3.7 & MOET Unit 7: House Review, Modal Verbs & School Projects

cards.vietnamese: Động từ khiếm khuyết chỉ khả năng: could / might (có thể), must (chắc chắn)
cards.definition: Verbs used to show how certain we are about a possibility in the present or future.
cards.example: It might be an eco-house because it has solar panels.

cards.vietnamese: Giải các bài toán, tính toán số học
cards.definition: To find an answer or solution to mathematical exercises.
cards.example: I like maths because I enjoy solving challenging problems.

cards.definition: Able to be used for a practical purpose or in several ways.
cards.example: I think a bilingual dictionary is very useful for learning new words.

cards.vietnamese: Tốt cho hoạt động làm việc nhóm
cards.example: Team sports and science projects are very good for group work.

cards.phonetic: [Why does he like...? - Because he thinks it's...]
cards.vietnamese: Hỏi lý do thích hoạt động: Why do you like...? - Because I think it's interesting.
cards.definition: Expressing opinions about why someone enjoys a particular activity.
cards.example: Why does she like reading? - Because she thinks it's interesting.

cards.vietnamese: Làm dự án học tập, nghiên cứu theo nhóm
cards.definition: To work on an educational assignment over a period of time.
cards.example: Students do science projects together in class.

exercises.question: Look at the dark clouds! It ________ rain later this afternoon.
exercises.explanation: Dùng modal verb 'might' để diễn tả khả năng có thể xảy ra trong tương lai.

exercises.question: What school activity does Linda like? — She likes ________ maths problems.
exercises.explanation: Sau động từ like dùng V-ing: likes solving.

exercises.question: Why does Nam like reading comic books? — ________ he thinks it's entertaining.
exercises.explanation: Hỏi với 'Why' trả lời bắt đầu bằng 'Because'.

exercises.question: A dictionary is very ________ for looking up unknown English words.
exercises.explanation: Useful có nghĩa là hữu ích, có giá trị sử dụng.

exercises.question: Doing science projects together is very good for ________.
exercises.explanation: Làm dự án khoa học theo đội rất tốt cho kỹ năng làm việc nhóm (group work).
